title: Zero In Demi-Diamond Clothes Moth Trap Refill Pads 2 Pack – Pheromone Glue Boards & Lifetime Indicator – Monitors Clothes Moth Infestations Up to 24 Weeks – Poison-Free Wardrobe & Drawer Protection
bullet_points: MAXIMUM CATCH-RATE PHEROMONE TECHNOLOGY – Replacement refill pads for the Zero In Demi-Diamond Clothes Moth Trap (ZER437) using the latest pheromone technology to attract male clothes moths onto the sticky glue pad, delivering maximum catch rates for reliable infestation monitoring.

MONITORS INFESTATIONS FOR UP TO 24 WEEKS – Each pack contains 2x pheromone glue pads and 2x lifetime indicators, providing up to 24 weeks (6 months) of continuous clothes moth detection and monitoring in wardrobes, drawers, blanket boxes and clothes storage units.

BUILT-IN LIFETIME INDICATOR TIMER – Innovative visual indicator gradually fills with red ink over 12 weeks, providing a clear at-a-glance reminder of exactly when it is time to replace the glue pad and indicator. Press firmly on the button to activate, then slide back into the trap unit.

POISON-FREE & SAFE FOR CLOTHING – Uses a natural pheromone attractant to lure and trap male clothes moths on the sticky glue surface. Contains no chemicals, no sprays, no poison. Safe for use in and around wardrobes, drawers, clothes storage areas and anywhere natural fibre clothing is kept.

EASY TO FIT & REPLACE – Simply remove the old glue pad and indicator from the unit, peel back the release paper from a new pad to activate the pheromone, fit with sticky side facing outwards, and click the new lifetime indicator into place. For use only with Zero In Demi-Diamond trap (ZER437).
